{{Quote|Sabotaged? No&hellip;Tavoy and Watkins&hellip;|Shara, upon finding Watkins dead|<ref name="ES" />}}
'''Watkins''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who fought in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on the side of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. A member of [[Grey Squadron]], a [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]] unit under the command of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[X2]], Watkins participated in a [[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in search of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[X1]]. On Dathomir, Watkins was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when an [[Unidentified Imperial saboteur|Imperial saboteur]] planted a [[detonation pack]] on the pilot's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]].

==Biography==
===Mission to Dathomir===
{{Quote|I know we're trying to avoid detection,&hellip;but did we really have to land in this swamp?|Shara|<ref name="ES" />}}
[[File:Grey_Squadron_Dathomir.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Grey Squadron arrives on Dathomir.]]
Watkins was the name of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Watkins was a member of [[Grey Squadron]], a [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic military]] unit led by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[X2]].<ref name="ES" /> At some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] and [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Grey [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] embarked on a [[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Watkins and the other pilots were following [[New Republic Intelligence Service|intelligence]] reports indicating that X2's brother, the Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[X1]], was operating on the planet.<ref name="ES" />

Watkins and the rest of Grey Squadron arrived on Dathomir using [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]], landing amidst the planet's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] to avoid detection. The squadron soon discovered an Imperial [[X1's Dathomir base|base]] that had belonged to X1. Now mostly abandoned, the base was being overrun by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] clan of the local [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]], who fought the few remaining Imperials left behind on the planet. While Watkins and most of the squadron remained with their [[Starship/Legends|ships]] at the landing site, X2 and three other squadron members cleared out the base from both the Nightsisters and [[X1's faction|X1's troops]]. X2 and Grey Squadron member [[Shara]] then went inside the base to extract data from X1's personal [[Computer/Legends|computer]].<ref name="ES" />

===Death===
{{Quote|What the&mdash;What happened here&hellip;?!''"<br />"''It looks like someone planted detpacks on our ships, sir.|X2 and a member of Grey Squadron|<ref name="ES" />}}
[[File:Grey_Squadron_went_boom.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The aftermath of the attack that took Watkins' life]]
Meanwhile, [[Unidentified Imperial saboteur|one of X1's Imperials]] was able to infiltrate the squadron's landing site undetected, planting [[detonation pack]]s onto the squadron's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]. When the explosives detonated, the [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] resulted in heavy casualties for Grey Squadron, with Watkins [[Death/Legends|falling victim]] to it, alongside fellow pilots [[Tavoy]] and [[Ryder]].<ref name="ES" />

The surviving members of the squadron captured the Imperial saboteur responsible for the attack by the [[Time/Legends|time]] X2 and Shara returned. Distraught at the loss of Watkins and his other squadron mates, X2 briefly let his anger take hold of him and [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-choked]] the Imperial, before Shara calmed him down. The remainder of Grey Squadron then proceeded to destroy an [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] and left the planet.<ref name="ES" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Watkins was featured in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'', developed by [[N-Space|N-space]] and released in [[2009]]. Watkins was briefly mentioned as one of the Grey Squadron pilots killed during the mission to Dathomir, and neither the character's [[Species/Legends|species]] nor gender were established in the game.<ref name="ES" />
